release_rules.correction_policy: Create a new dataset version rather than editing an immutable release.

generation_notes.row_target_policy: Use explicit per-table row_targets. Dev is intentionally small and is not required to equal exactly 1% of full.
generation_notes.manifest_timestamp_policy: manifest_generated_at is fixed per dataset version to preserve byte-identical regeneration.
generation_notes.domain_boundary: CRM covers account and contact engagement, campaign attribution, and support-case SLA analysis.
